pageIntro: Structured as outputs, outcomes, and impact. Outputs are what we delivered; outcomes are what changed in people; impact is whether behaviour changed six months later. Only the third is evidence the programme works.
tier1Gloss: What we delivered. Necessary for reporting, not evidence of impact.
tier2Gloss: What changed in people, matched per participant. Mentors excluded: experienced volunteers start near the top and would flatten the result.
tier2Empty: No matched pre/post pairs yet. Numbers appear once participants have completed both the registration survey and the post-event survey.
tier3Gloss: Whether behaviour actually changed, six months on. This is what R3 evaluation exists to measure, and the only tier that answers whether the programme works.
tier3Empty: No six-month follow-ups returned yet. These send automatically 180 days after an event, so the first results arrive six months after your first event held under the new survey system.
byEventNote: Attendance counts include mentors, shown as (Nm). Survey counts exclude them.
barriersHeading: What would help them get out more
